description: Head-movement mini-game G02: slow alternating turn-count exercise. Voice-guided, segmented motion only — turn left, hold, return to center, turn right, hold, return to center, 5 left + 5 right = 10 reps. A one-prompt start calibration (turn left once) learns which yaw sign means left. Temple tap starts and replays; no camera, no mic/ASR.
name: turn-count
